entity_name: Beirut and Mount Lebanon Water Establishment (مؤسسة مياه بيروت وجبل لبنان)

facts.value: Beirut and Mount Lebanon Water Establishment. Manages potable water supply, billing, and pipe network for Beirut city and Mount Lebanon governorate. Handles water outages, pipe leaks, dirty water, billing disputes, and new connection requests in its service area. Complaint domains encoded for routing: water_outage, dirty_water, pipe_leak_public, water_pressure_low, meter_billing_dispute, new_water_connection, water_contamination, irrigation_water_issue, sewage_overflow_linked_to_water_network.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: electricity(EDL); road_damage(MUN_MPWT); private_building_plumbing; rainfall_flooding(CD_MUN); private_building_plumbing_or_rooftop_tank; Route instead to PRIVATE_PROPERTY_OR_BUILDING_MANAGEMENT when No public meter public pipe public source or neighborhood-wide evidence.; local_rainwater_storm_drain_or_road_drainage; Route instead to MUN_OR_MPWT_BY_ROAD_CLASS when Complaint is rainwater/stormwater without sewer or public water network evidence.; electricity_fault_powering_pumps; Route instead to EDL_OR_EDZ_CONTEXT_ONLY when Complaint is solely grid electricity; public water outage remains BMLWE if citizen lacks water.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.
